versions.changelog:
china-tax-calculator v0.1.4

- Major framework update: moved/merged files from subdirectory to top-level for a cleaner structure.
- Added new features in documentation, including年终奖陷阱预警, 批量计算, 税负优化建议, and历史税率对比.
- Expanded功能清单 and supported city list for社保公积金 calculations.
- Skill metadata now includes more tags, reflecting extensive new capabilities such as Excel导出, 可视化图表, and历史税率分析.
- Deprecated duplicate/legacy files in the former subdirectory location.

china-tax-calculator v0.1.3

- Initial code release with main logic in lib/tax_calc.py
- Added SKILL.md with feature descriptions and usage instructions
- Introduced skill.json for skill metadata and configuration

china-tax-calculator v0.1.2

- 新增“涨薪效果分析”功能，自动计算涨薪后实际到手增加
- 增加8种快速场景模板（如单身、已婚一孩等），一键应用专项附加扣除
- 支持交互式问答，智能引导补全个税计算信息
- 可生成完整的飞书 Markdown 个税报告
- 技能标签新增“涨薪分析”“飞书报告”

v0.1.1 introduces major new features for China personal income tax calculation:

- 新增年度汇算清缴：支持年度应补/应退税额计算
- 支持多收入来源：工资、劳务、稿酬、特许权使用费可合并计税
- 年终奖智能优化：自动寻找最优计税分配方式
- 增加跳槽薪资谈判、Offer对比等场景支持
- 文档与描述全面更新，体现所有新增功能

china-tax-calculator v0.1.0

- Initial release of a professional Chinese personal income tax calculator.
- Supports monthly salary tax calculation, year-end bonus (annual award) calculation (separate or combined), and 7 types of special additional deductions.
- Provides reverse calculation from after-tax to pre-tax income.
- Generates detailed personal income tax reports.
- Includes 2025 tax rates and deduction standards for accurate and compliant calculations.
